cs_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: Sometimes also called `RS`. For ST7920 should be inverted.

*See also: [ST7920 LCD Graphic Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/st7920#configuration-variables)*

height.docs:
**int**: The "height" of a screen. Defaults to 64;

*See also: [ST7920 LCD Graphic Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/st7920#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [ST7920 LCD Graphic Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/st7920#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to re-draw the screen. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [ST7920 LCD Graphic Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/st7920#configuration-variables)*

width.docs:
**int**: The "width" of a screen. Defaults to 128.

*See also: [ST7920 LCD Graphic Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/st7920#configuration-variables)*

rotation.docs:
Set the rotation of the display. Everything you draw in `lambda:` will be rotated by this option. One of `0°` (default), `90°`, `180°`, `270°`.

*See also: [ST7920 LCD Graphic Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/st7920#configuration-variables)*

lambda.docs:
**[lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)**: The lambda to use for rendering the content on the display. See [Display Rendering Engine](https://esphome.io/components/display#display-engine) for more information.

*See also: [ST7920 LCD Graphic Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/st7920#configuration-variables)*

pages.docs:
**list**: Show pages instead of a single lambda. See [Display Pages](https://esphome.io/components/display#display-pages).

*See also: [ST7920 LCD Graphic Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/st7920#configuration-variables)*
